Blade Runner

Ridley Scott’s 1982 film set in a rain-soaked Los Angeles of 2019, whose dark, neon-lit, high-tech but decaying city became the visual model for cyberpunk.

Source
Wikipedia: Blade Runner
Creator
Ridley Scott (director); Syd Mead (concept artist); Lawrence G. Paull (production designer); Jordan Cronenweth (cinematographer)
Made
1982 (released 25 June 1982)
Style
Cyberpunk (agent-proposed, not yet reviewed by a person)
Moods
Dystopian, nocturnal, gritty, melancholy
Evidence
Based on the Wikipedia article, read as wikitext on 2026-10-02. No image of the film was inspected for this record.
Reviewed
2 October 2026
Rights
Link and metadata only. License: unverified. Rights policy

Context

Wikipedia: “Hailed for its production design depicting a high-tech but decaying future, the film is often regarded as both a leading example of neo-noir cinema and a foundational work of the cyberpunk genre.” Wikipedia.

Scott used Edward Hopper’s Nighthawks and the French comics magazine Métal Hurlant as mood sources, and drew on the landscape of “Hong Kong on a very bad day”. He hired Syd Mead as concept artist. Production designer Lawrence G. Paull and art director David Snyder realized Scott’s and Mead’s sketches. Wikipedia.

Wikipedia notes that the film’s look, “in particular its overall darkness, preponderance of neon lights and opaque visuals”, made it a popular reference point for video games. Wikipedia.

Why it belongs

The film fixed the core of the style’s imagery: night, rain, neon, and advertising on a scale that dwarfs people. Most later works quote it, including Cyberpunk 2077.

Its link to film noir explains why the style is dark and lit by small, hard sources instead of daylight.

Borrow

Keep most of the frame dark and let a few signs, screens, or advertisements carry all the light.

Pair high-tech elements with signs of wear and decay so that the future looks used.

What to review next

  • Find an openly licensed or museum-documented still, or a production design drawing, that can be inspected, and upgrade the evidence level.
